decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to utilize cheap cantrips and spells to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures like Arclight Phoenix. By casting spells to trigger the Phoenix's ability, you can bring it back from the graveyard multiple times in a single turn, overwhelming your opponent with constant pressure and aggression. The deck also incorporates disruption with cards like Spell Pierce and Ashiok, Dream Render to disrupt your opponent's plans while also fueling your own graveyard strategy. Additionally, the deck includes removal spells like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse to deal with threats from the opponent.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on fast-paced, aggressive strategies to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creatures and burn spells. The deck seeks to establish a board presence quickly and deal damage efficiently with cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Slickshot Show-Off, and Questing Druid. To protect its creatures and push through damage, the deck includes cards like Blossoming Defense and Audacity. The inclusion of Boseiju, Who Endures and other lands that produce red mana ensures that the deck can consistently cast its powerful burn spells.

This deck focuses on using the combo potential of Amalia Benavides Aguirre to generate a large amount of life gain through cards like Wildgrowth Walker and Aetherflux Reservoir. By tutoring for key combo pieces with cards like Chord of Calling and Fauna Shaman, the deck aims to quickly assemble its win condition. The inclusion of cards like Selfless Savior and Skyclave Apparition provide protection and removal options to help the deck stabilize while setting up its combo. With efficient mana fixing and ramp, the deck looks to overwhelm opponents with its lifegain and combo potential.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly cast spells to fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes, while also using disruptive spells and creatures to control the board. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and hard-to-answer threats, such as Otawara, Soaring City and Picklock Prankster. The inclusion of versatile cards like Brazen Borrower and Galvanic Iteration adds flexibility to the deck's game plan. The strategy revolves around efficiently utilizing spells and creatures to maintain pressure on the opponent and secure victories.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Questing Druid and Monastery Swiftspear, supported by pump spells like Atarka's Command and Monstrous Rage. The deck aims to rush opponents down with a combination of burn spells and efficient creatures, while having access to Jegantha, the Wellspring as a powerful companion option. The deck also includes protection spells like Blossoming Defense and creatures with special abilities like Soul-Scar Mage to disrupt opponents' strategies. With a strong mana base and versatile threats, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures and utilizing combat tricks and burn spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan and rapidly reduce their life total. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck. The mana base is also designed to ensure smooth mana curve while maximizing the potential damage output of the creatures. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient threats and efficient removal spells, often aiming to close the game in the early to mid-game.

This deck focuses on utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful control tool. It includes a variety of versatile spells such as Lightning Helix, Vanishing Verse, and Bring to Light to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes powerful multicolored cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Leyline Binding to generate value and pressure the opponent. With a mix of removal, card draw, and threats, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a grindy game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. It aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan while dealing direct damage to win the game quickly. Cards like Fatal Push and Fiery Temper help maintain board control, while cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Bloodtithe Harvester put pressure on the opponent's life total. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Duress and Thoughtseize to further disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to be fast, aggressive, and disruptive.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells and getting Arclight Phoenix into the graveyard to bring it back into play multiple times. It includes cards like Opt and Treasure Cruise for card draw, fi, rey spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to help remove threats, and ways to generate treasure tokens to help with mana. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and explosive plays, utilizing the graveyard as a resource to continuously bring back Arclight Phoenix and apply pressure.

This deck focuses on using a wide range of cards to control the pace of the game and out-value the opponent. It utilizes Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a key card to draw multiple cards and gain advantage. The deck includes a variety of removal spells, card draw, and versatile answers to deal with different threats. It also includes powerful planeswalkers and a companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, to provide additional value and options. The goal is to maintain control of the board while generating card advantage to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on utilizing Greasefang and Parhelion II to create a powerful combo synergy. It also includes cards that enable graveyard manipulation, card draw, removal, and disruption to control the game state. The land base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and provide consistent mana access. The use of Thoughtseize, Duress, and Ashiok, Dream Render allows for disruption of the opponent's strategy, while cards like Raffine's Informant and Bitter Triumph offer card advantage and tempo advantage. Overall, the deck aims to create a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent with its combo potential.

The main focus of this Pioneer 1 vs 1 Aggro - Weenie White deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of low-cost creatures and pump them up with various anthem effects like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar. By utilizing efficient creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and creating a wide board presence with cards like Mutavault, the deck aims to quickly pressure the opponent and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize. Additionally, disruptive elements like Containment Priest and Brave the Elements help protect the deck's threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and using disruptive spells to control the opponent's hand and board state. It utilizes a mix of creature aggression and removal spells to apply pressure and maintain board control. With a mix of low-cost creatures and efficient removal, the key strategy is to quickly build a threatening board presence and disrupt the opponent's plans through hand disruption and removal spells. The deck also incorporates a strong mana base to ensure consistency in casting its spells and utilizing its abilities effectively.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Amalia Life combo to generate a high amount of life gain and value through cards like Prosperous Innkeeper and Wildgrowth Walker. The deck also has strong creature and spell synergy using Chord of Calling and Collected Company to quickly assemble the necessary pieces for the combo. Additionally, the deck includes a mix of utility creatures and disruption spells like Selfless Savior and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and disrupt opponent's strategies. The mana base is designed to support the combo with a mix of dual lands and mana fixing cards.

The main focus of this Red Deck Wins deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using efficient burn spells and creature abilities. The deck includes cards like Soul-Scar Mage and Monastery Swiftspear to increase damage output, along with powerful burn spells like Wizard's Lightning and Play with Fire. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion allows for additional flexibility in deck building. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, high-powered attacks and burn spells to secure a quick victory.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while generating value from discarding cards and controlling the board. By using cards like Thoughtseize, Duress, and Go Blank to strip the opponent's hand, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act, the deck aims to maintain board control. Cards like Waste Not and Geier Reach Sanitarium allow for card advantage and resource generation, while powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal provide a way to close out the game.
